data.name: Daniya
data.gender_notes: Daniya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman given as a gift or a graceful, little or small woman. The name Daniya carries the meaning “Gift, Grace, Small, Little” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Daniya usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, grace, small, little and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Daniya signifies the divine grace bestowed upon a woman. It symbolizes the nurturing and caring nature of a mother, who gives life and fosters growth. It is a reminder of the blessings and gifts that Allah has given us.
data.etymology: Daniya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Grace, Small, Little.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daniya total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
